title: MCP register_student Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `register_student` tool response, built by `_serialize_registration`. U4/KD9/R16: only the newly minted opaque student_id is ever returned — the registered attributes exist solely inside IdentityRegistry's own file from this point on and are never echoed back over this transport.

student_id.description: The opaque, cryptographically-random student id this consumer's registered attributes were assigned (orchestrator/identity.py's IdentityRegistry.register_student).
